column1: # One estimated just-noticeable difference per score column, in that column's units.
# Source: KonJND-1k (1,008 pairs, 640x480, 504 JPEG + 504 BPG, distorted level at each image's
# mean picture-wise JND threshold, round-half-up; method in benchmarks/nn_konjnd_scale_2026-10-15.md),
# scored by pyiqa 0.1.16 itself (CPU fp32; models/topiq/konjnd_score.py, 2026-10-17, i265);
# value = pooled median over the 1,008 pairs (models/topiq/konjnd_summary.py).
# topiq_fr and topiq_fr_pipal are higher-is-better with an image-dependent identical-pair score,
# so their JND is the median of |score(ref, dist) - score(ref, ref)|.
# Used by tests/parity.rs to express engine tolerance in JND units (TOL_JND = 1e-3).
# *_pyiqa columns (2026-10-17/18, i265, models/common/konjnd_score.py): wadiqam_pyiqa and ahiq_pyiqa
# use |score(ref, dist) - score(ref, ref)| (image-dependent identical-pair score); cw_ssim_pyiqa
# |1 - score|; dmm_pyiqa and pieapp_pyiqa the score itself (identical pairs ~0). ahiq_pyiqa's scores
# come from this crate's port on ort-cuda (pyiqa needs ~80 s per pair on CPU; the port matches pyiqa
# within 1.2e-5 JND); the others from pyiqa itself.
